decisions.reason: J_LED_CHG is a separate external charge-LED connector; the source does not change J_PWR_SIGNAL or its interboard signal pinout.
The charge-status LED connector and R6/D1 population changes do not alter J_BAT, its battery pinout, or its connector standard.
The source changes charge-status indication hardware but does not change battery cutoff, thermal sensing, or protection behavior.
Adding J_LED_CHG and changing charge-status component population do not modify the power-input TVS ESD protection requirement.
The source does not change J_PWR_POWER, its connector type, or the rule that power-board and main-board pin orders must match.
The external charge-status LED circuit does not change ESP32 clocking, sleep policy, or wake sources.
The CHGLED circuit and R6/D1 changes are independent of the GPIO3-controlled MT3608 sensor-power rail.
Although a connector is added to the power board, the source specifies no new placement, orientation, spacing, clearance, or board-size constraint.
R6 is identified here as part of the CHGLED circuit; the source does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, speed, or cabling.
The existing generic requirement to mark connector pins remains valid unchanged; the source adds J_LED_CHG but specifies no labeling change or pin-label details.
The charge-status circuit change does not alter the three-board architecture or the defined roles of the main and sensor boards.
The source specifies component changes but does not resume or modify the deferred task requiring JLCPCB assembly part numbers.
